title: H1 fix round 1: _tokens_of keeps the discounted cache-read convention for normalised rows, and the legacy total-only detection matches only rows without normalised buckets (review T-0367)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 4f2a9ef (T-0356, H1) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0367 on T-0356, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/scorecard.py:384 _tokens_of returns int(entry['total_tokens']) whenever the key is present, bypassing the documented cache_read // 10 discount; since spawn.py:396 merges bus.normalize_usage (which always sets total_tokens) into every Claude run row, nearly every real row hits that branch and cache-heavy runs are inflated in by_task, by_goal, tokens_per_accepted_goal and failed_tokens. Restore the convention: when a row carries normalised buckets (input_uncached_tokens present), compute the discounted total from the buckets exactly as the pre-H1 code did for raw fields; use total_tokens verbatim only for genuinely legacy rows that carry total_tokens and no bucket fields at all. Add test_tokens_of_discounts_cache_read_on_normalised_rows (a row with total_tokens set and cache_read nonzero yields the discounted value, not total_tokens).
2. (med) orchestrator/scorecard.py:545 the legacy total-only check (total_tokens is not None or 'input_uncached_tokens' in entry) also matches normalised rows, so tokens(entry) reads the old raw key names and exports zero uncached/cache_read/cache_write buckets for them. Make the predicate: legacy = total_tokens present and no normalised or raw bucket key present; for normalised rows read the normalised keys so tokens_uncached, tokens_cache_read and tokens_cache_write are exact. Add test_by_goal_buckets_exact_for_normalised_rows.
Keep the four T-0356 tests and every existing test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 4f2a9ef below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
